name: Gmail
examples_zh: 查找最近 7 天来自 boss@company.com 且带附件的未读 Gmail 邮件，并列出主题、发件人和收件时间。
给 customer@example.com 发送一封 Gmail 邮件，主题为"项目 Alpha 周报"，正文附上本周进展摘要。
把包含"invoice"关键词的 Gmail 会话统一加上"财务待处理"标签，并跳过已归档邮件。
examples_en: Find unread Gmail messages from boss@company.com in the last 7 days that include attachments, then list the subject, sender, and received time.
Send a Gmail email to customer@example.com with the subject "Project Alpha Weekly Update" and a short progress summary in the body.
Add the Gmail label "Finance Pending" to threads containing the keyword "invoice", excluding archived conversations.
description_zh: 通过 Gmail API 收发邮件、管理标签和草稿
description_en: Read, send, and manage Gmail emails, threads, labels, and drafts via API
